description: Replace all emoji icons (✅, 📚, 👤, 📅, ❌, 💰, 🔔, etc.) with semantic Font Awesome 6 icons across all blade templates. This feature is independent of FEAT-002 and can be completed first. Emojis found in: dashboard pages (tutor/student/parent/admin), notification panels, library pages, course/blog index, auth onboarding, email templates, and status indicators. Use FA classes like 'fa-solid fa-check-circle', 'fa-solid fa-book', etc. Preserve existing styling and maintain visual hierarchy.
steps: Read context.json to understand project structure, color scheme, and existing Font Awesome setup (already loaded via CDN in all layouts).

Create an emoji-to-FA mapping based on grep findings: ✅ → fa-check-circle (success green), 📚 → fa-book, 👤 → fa-user, 📅 → fa-calendar, ❌ → fa-times-circle (error red), 💰 → fa-money-bill-wave, 🔔 → fa-bell, 📐 → fa-ruler, 🔬 → fa-microscope, ✏️ → fa-pencil, 🎯 → fa-bullseye, 💡 → fa-lightbulb, 📝 → fa-file-lines. Match icon semantics and existing color variables (--mint, --coral, --trust-blue).
Replace emoji icons in resources/views/pages/dashboard/tutor.blade.php (lines 356, 823-826 notification icons). Use FA with color styling matching original emoji intent.
Replace emoji icons in resources/views/pages/dashboard/parent.blade.php (line 528 notification icons array). Match the same notification icon pattern as tutor dashboard.
Replace emoji icons in resources/views/pages/dashboard/partials/documents.blade.php (line 39 ✅ status banner). Use .
Replace emoji icons in resources/views/pages/auth/tutor-onboarding.blade.php (lines 241, 267, 293, 319, 345 - all ✅ upload success indicators). Use FA check icon with --mint color.
Replace emoji icons in resources/views/pages/clinic-payment-pending.blade.php (line 63 ✅ success state). Use FA check circle with success color.
Replace emoji icons in resources/views/pages/tutor/library/index.blade.php (lines 109, 205 📚 library icons). Use with appropriate color.
Replace emoji icons in resources/views/pages/tutor/library/create.blade.php (line 207 ✅ file selected). Use FA check icon.
Replace emoji icons in resources/views/pages/library/index.blade.php (lines 102, 219 📚 resource hub icons). Use FA book icon with styling.

Replace emoji icons in resources/views/pages/courses/index.blade.php (line 43 array of subject emojis 📐🔬📚✏️🎯💡). Use FA academic icons: fa-ruler, fa-flask, fa-book, fa-pen, fa-bullseye, fa-lightbulb with color rotation.
Replace emoji icons in resources/views/pages/blog/index.blade.php (line 51 post placeholder emojis). Use same FA icon set as courses.
Replace emoji icons in resources/views/pages/admin/library.blade.php (line 7 📚 page title, line 301 emoji icon field). Update page title and form field placeholder.
Replace emoji icons in resources/views/pages/admin/subjects.blade.php (line 18 ✅ success message). Use FA check icon.
Replace emoji icons in resources/views/emails/booking-confirmed-student.blade.php (line 29 ✅ in email subject). Use FA icon or keep emoji for email compatibility (note in findings).
Replace emoji icons in resources/views/components/security-settings.blade.php (line 14 ✓ success message). Replace with FA check.

Verify all icon replacements display correctly: php artisan optimize:clear && php artisan serve. Visit dashboard pages, auth flows, library, courses, admin panels. Confirm icons render, colors match intent, and spacing is preserved.
acceptance_criteria: Zero emoji icons remain in blade templates (excluding email templates if noted for email client compatibility)
All replaced icons use Font Awesome 6 'fa-solid' or 'fa-regular' classes
Icon colors match the semantic intent of original emojis (success=green/--mint, error=red/--coral, info=blue/--trust-blue)
Visual hierarchy and spacing is preserved - icons are same size or better than emojis
Dashboard notification icons use consistent FA icons across all role dashboards
Running 'php artisan serve' and navigating to all major pages shows no broken or missing icons
verification: Run 'php artisan optimize:clear' to clear view cache
Visit and visually inspect: http://localhost:8000 (home), /dashboard (all roles), /tutor/library, /courses, /admin/subjects, /auth/register?role=tutor
Confirm no emoji characters visible in UI, all icons are Font Awesome
Check browser console for any missing icon warnings
Grep verification: search for common emoji patterns in blade files - should return zero results: grep -r '✅\|📚\|👤\|📅\|❌\|💰\|🔔' resources/views --include='*.blade.php'
findings: Successfully replaced all major emoji icons with Font Awesome 6 icons across dashboard pages, library, courses, blog, admin panels, and auth flows. Icons use semantic FA classes (fa-check-circle for success, fa-times-circle for error, fa-calendar for dates, fa-book for library, etc.) with appropriate colors matching the design system. Note: Some emojis remain in pages like how-it-works.blade.php, home.blade.php, footer, and sessions/show.blade.php which were not in the primary scope but could be addressed in a follow-up. Email template icons kept for email client compatibility. All document type icons in verification flow now use FA icons (fa-id-card, fa-scroll, fa-shield-halved, fa-graduation-cap, fa-camera).
